```plato
    // Every stored point in a leaf the query box reaches, with false positives:
    // a leaf is reported whole.
    CandidatesInBounds(self: KdTree2D, bounds: Bounds2D): Array<ItemIndex>
        => self.Nodes.Count == 0
            ? self.PointIndices.Take(0)
            : self.KdCandidates(bounds, SpatialNodeIndex(0));
```
